ops.title: Represent the immutable diagnostic checkout in the CI source contract
ops.description: Owner: /root/ccx_targeted_stack_io. Root source inquiry found the manual baseline fetch preserves the immutable SHA but hides its distinct diagnostic role from the blanket actions/checkout count invariant. Restore the explicit baseline checkout and allow exactly one complete immutable59bb/path/no-credentials block only in coholder-path-cost; retain the existing candidate exact-ref count contract elsewhere. Add direct positive and negative validator cases, independent source review, normal CI/main landing. Isolated source at ccx-coholder-checkout-contract; no product behavior changes. Core0.89.10 publication/install remains independent. CI-only repair requires deployed main workflow/test proof, no separate local binary update.

ops.text: Source review and actual CI prove exactly one immutable diagnostic baseline, with intended negative diagnostics and all other candidate checkout bindings retained
Normal main merge deploys the scoped contract and explicit baseline; record actual workflow execution without claiming whole-pipeline green or requiring unrelated local binary activation
